profile.headline: Software Engineer at USAA
profile.summary: Highly motivated “Fuller Stack” Software Engineer. Taking initiative to implement Lean and Agile cultural philosophies, practices, and tools.

positions.title: USAA Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Agile SCRUM individual contributor & lead developer
• Agile tools - Atlassian JIRA, Gitlab, OpenShift, Artifactory, and ELK 
• Develop web application with JAVA, Spring, Gradle, and SpringBoot 
• Integration & testing using bash, restassured

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Agile SCRUM individual contributor
• Agile tools - Atlassian JIRA, Stash, Bamboo, Nexus, and Coverity
• Develop web application with JAVA, Spring, Camel, and maven
• Integration & testing using Chef, bash, and SoapUI

positions.title: Student President - E-Sports Organization
positions.description:
• Elected President of the E-Sports Organization in Texas A&M University-Central Texas
• Voted the Senator of Management & Marketing by Student Council
• Voted the Senator of Computer Information by Student Council
• Appointed Marketing Director of Student Government
• Organized an E-Sports competitive gaming event with over 50 attendees during Geekfest 2012

positions.title: Intelligence Analyst
positions.description:
• Honorably discharged from the US Army with the highest attained rank of Sergeant
• Advised, presented, and developed intelligence products for high ranking officials on matters related to military intelligence
• Coordinated work assignments, evaluated performance, and directed a 6-member analyst cell
• Recognized for excellence in supervising, training, and leading the Multi-National Coalition in Iraq analyst cell
• Developed and maintained a JavaScript/HTML/CSS intelligence web site for effective dissemination of intelligence materials

honors.title: Suma Cum Laude
honors.issuer: Issued by Texas A&M University-Central Texas · Dec 2013

honors.title: Army Commendation Medal
honors.description: For meritorious service as a Sergeant in the US Army.

volunteerExperiences.description: Army Community Service (ACS) facilitates a commander's ability to provide comprehensive, coordinated, and responsive services that support the readiness of soldiers, civilian employees, and their families.
FIRST LEGO® League (FLL) is one of four competitive levels designed by FIRST, using LEGO® Mindstorms NXT robotics kids as its platform.
